title: Compilation project of the Corrected Meanings of the Five Classics
shortSummary: A multi-year early Tang editorial project brought commentarial traditions into state education and examination knowledge.
curatorialDescription: A range is used because compilation, revision, presentation and institutional use were not one event.
researchNote: Commission, revision, submission and use must be separated through histories, catalogues and edition studies.
